input.description: A small shower area with white square tiles covering the walls. In the corner, there is a built-in soap dish. The shower floor is also white, with some minor discoloration or stains visible near the drain area. A chrome shower control handle is mounted on the wall, with a shiny, reflective surface. Above the control handle, a flexible metal shower hose is attached, leading up to a shower caddy. The caddy is white and holds several items, including a red and white striped bottle and a green bar of soap. The overall appearance is clean and functional, with a simple and minimalist design.
all_user_responses: I am preparing to clean the shower, so these are going to be the before pictures and then I will take the after pictures to see if I have successfully improved the cleanliness of the shower area
Considering all of the images so far, on a one to 10 scale with 10 being the dirtiest and one being the cleanest, please rank the overall cleanliness of the shower area

The next series of pictures will be the after cleaning pictures and I would appreciate it if you could rank them on a one to 10 again now that I’ve cleaned them, with one being the worst and then being the cleanest
No, on a scale of one to 10 with one being the worst and 10 being the best, please give me a score on the cleanliness from that last image

This is probably the best I can do without visual assistance. I will engage my fully sided son to use and more aggressive cleaning product on the areas that still require attention, but thank you for helping me better understand the progress from my cleaning.
